Shoulder-length, wavy cinnamon-brown hair with voluminous curls. Large, expressive amber-gold eyes. Apparent age is early twenties with a soft, youthful face. Petite, curvy build. Wears a traditional desert wrap in sandy ochre and turquoise with gold beadwork along the edges. A matching turquoise veil covers the lower face.
BODY COLOR: olive tan
